svg.title: Sound engineer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as sound engineer, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: Three fader channels on a mixing console sit at deliberately different levels. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face and round glasses.
